lead.question: 耗资十亿美元的哈勃望远镜，为何一上天就出故障，还要派宇航员修理？
lead.warmup: 1990年4月20日，NASA 耗资十多亿美元把哈勃望远镜送入太空，本指望它摆脱大气层的干扰，拍下人类从未见过的清晰星空。谁知从最开始就出问题：主镜有误差，传回的照片令人失望。于是航天局派奋进号航天飞机送四名宇航员上天，用机械臂抓住望远镜，在太空里把它修好。
goals: 复述哈勃望远镜发射、主镜故障与太空维修的全过程
辨析并运用将来进行时、将来完成时与将来完成进行时
熟练使用 at a cost of、right from the start、put ... right、thousands and thousands of、above the earth's atmosphere
掌握最高级后接 ever + 现在完成时的定语从句，并能区分 cost、price、value
lead.summary: 本课讲哈勃望远镜耗资十多亿美元上天却因主镜故障失灵，再由奋进号送宇航员修复。语法重点是三种将来时：will be taking 表计划中的持续动作，will have sent 表到你读到本文时已完成的成果，will have been sending 表延续到将来的过程。
lead.tips: by the time 引导的时间状语从句要用一般现在时代替将来时；cost 指工程费用，price 指商品价钱，value 指抽象价值。

questions.q: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
questions.zh: 太空中的望远镜有什么特殊的重要性？
questions.a: Because it is above the earth's atmosphere, it can send us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen, and tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
questions.aZh: 因为它位于地球大气层之上，能发回人类所见过的最清晰的恒星与遥远星系的照片，还能告诉我们许多关于宇宙年龄与大小的信息。

questions.q: Why were the pictures the Hubble sent us very disappointing?
questions.zh: 为什么哈勃传回地球的照片令人非常失望？
questions.a: Because its main mirror was faulty.

questions.q: How will the four astronauts repair the Hubble?
questions.zh: 四名宇航员将如何修理哈勃望远镜？
questions.a: The shuttle Endeavour will take them to the Hubble, and a robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while they make the necessary repairs.
questions.aZh: 奋进号把他们送到哈勃处，机械臂抓住并托住望远镜，宇航员趁此进行必要的修理。

questions.q: What will the Hubble's eagle eye have done by the time you read this?
questions.zh: 到你读到这篇文章时，哈勃的鹰眼将会已经做了什么？
questions.a: It will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
questions.aZh: 它将已经为我们送来成千上万张精彩的照片。

questions.q: Why does the writer use 'will have sent' instead of 'will send', and how would 'will have been sending' change the meaning?
questions.zh: 作者为何用将来完成时？若改用将来完成进行时，语意有何变化？
questions.a: By the time you read this points to a future moment, so will have sent stresses completion by then. Will send would only state a future action. Will have been sending would shift the focus from the result to the continuous process.
questions.aZh: 将来完成时强调到那时已经完成；will send 只陈述将来动作；将来完成进行时把重点从结果转到延续的过程。
questions.hint: 对照将来完成时与将来完成进行时的定义。

exercises.q: 填空：The Hubble telescope was launched into space by NASA on April 20, 1990 ______ over a billion dollars.
exercises.note: at a cost of 表示耗资。

exercises.q: 填空：______ there was trouble with the Hubble.
填空：NASA is now going to ______ the telescope ______.（修好）
exercises.note: put sth. right 意为修好。

exercises.q: 汉译英：等你读到这篇文章时，敏锐的哈勃望远镜已经为我们送来了成千上万张精彩的照片。
exercises.a: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.

exercises.q: 用将来完成进行时填空：By next month, the Hubble ______ (send) us pictures for over thirty years.
填空：By the time you ______ (read) this, the Hubble will have sent us wonderful pictures.
exercises.note: 时间状语从句用现在时代替将来时。

exercises.q: 用所给动词的适当形式填空：The shuttle Endeavour ______ (take) the astronauts to the Hubble.

quiz.q: 课文表示耗资的正确短语是？
options: at a cost of over a billion dollars
at a price of over a billion dollars
with a value of over a billion dollars
in the cost of over a billion dollars
quiz.note: at a cost of 指工程费用。

quiz.q: 下面哪一句与课文一致，表示从最开始就有问题？
options: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
Right at the end there was trouble with the Hubble.
From the start right there was trouble to the Hubble.
Right from the start there had trouble with the Hubble.
quiz.note: right 强调 from the start。

quiz.q: NASA 准备把望远镜修好，课文中的原句是哪一句？
options: NASA is now going to put the telescope right.
NASA is now going to take the telescope right.
NASA is now going to put the telescope rightly.
NASA is now going to put the telescope correct.
quiz.note: put sth. right 意为修好。

quiz.q: 哈勃为什么能拍到人类所见过的最清晰的照片？
options: Because it is above the earth's atmosphere.
Because its main mirror was faulty.
Because it cost over a billion dollars.
Because four astronauts repaired it on the earth.

quiz.q: 到下星期这个时候，我就已经为这家公司工作二十年了，正确的时态是哪一句？
options: By this time next week, I will have been working for this firm for twenty years.
By this time next week, I will have worked for this firm for twenty years.
By this time next week, I will be working for this firm for twenty years.
By this time next week, I will work for this firm for twenty years.

quiz.q: 这是我们所见过的最清晰的照片，正确的英文是哪一个？
options: the clearest pictures that we have ever seen
the clearest pictures that we ever see
the clearest pictures that we had ever seen
the clearest pictures that we will ever see
quiz.note: 最高级后接现在完成时 + ever。
